# Characterisation: GE Profile PHS925ST1SS

Measured 2026-11-20 with OvenTracker simulated meter and a type K thermocouple.

## How far the adjustment moves the oven

| Mode | Gain | ±95 % | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bake | 0.90 | 0.03 | each degree of adjustment moves it 0.90 degrees |

A gain of 1.00 means the adjustment does exactly what it says. Under 1, the oven moves less than the setting; over 1, more.

## How the error changes with temperature

- Bake: its error is about the same at every setting, so one adjustment corrects it everywhere.

## Best adjustment, with the measured gains

**Bake: set the oven's thermostat adjustment to −9 °F (it's −10 °F now).**
